title: Norway Scenic Camper Route · Geiranger–Trollstigen
summary: A MapLibre globe and terrain route story with the official Geiranger–Trollstigen GPX track, four photo stops and vertical video export.
question: How can GeoLibre turn the Geiranger–Trollstigen Scenic Route into a self-contained 3D vertical route video?
interpretation: The video follows the official route in travel order, inserting viewpoint photos between route sections. MapLibre renders the globe, terrain and route from one GeoLibre project.
limitations: The official track includes the ferry crossing. Check current road access, weather restrictions and ferry schedules before travel.
104 km is the official published route length. The GPX-derived length appears in route.geojson.
Browser recording uses live WebGL rendering. MP4 availability depends on browser codec support.
The original GPX repeats the Gudbrandsjuvet–Trollstigen section. The video removes that duplicate return loop. Retained track geometry measures 105.556 km, compared with the published 104 km.
